timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Converts Unix timestamps into human readable UTC and local dates, and dates back into timestamps. Triggers on bare timestamps, ISO dates and keywords such as epoch or unix time.
timestamp.title: Unix timestamp

note.assumedUnit: Unit guessed from the number of digits: {unit}. Add a unit such as “ms” or “s” to the query to override it.
note.assumedUtc: No time zone given, so the date was read as UTC. Add Z, UTC or an offset such as +02:00 to change that.
note.outOfRange: This value is outside the range a date can represent (about ±275,000 years from 1970).

bareNumbers.label: Convert bare numbers
bareNumbers.description: Show the panel when the whole query is a number with at least 9 digits, even without a keyword. Keyword queries such as “epoch 86400” always work.

bareDates.label: Convert bare dates
bareDates.description: Show the panel when the whole query is an ISO 8601 date such as 2024-01-15 or 2024-01-15T10:30:00Z, even without a keyword.

timeFormat.label: Clock format
timeFormat.description: 12-hour, 24-hour, or follow the locale when set to auto.

extraTimeZones.label: Extra time zones
extraTimeZones.description: Comma-separated IANA time zones to list alongside UTC and your local time. Unknown zones are ignored.
